output.tldr: Bajaj Finance delivers strong top-line and profit growth, but terrible cash flows (negative CFO/FCF), high leverage, and aggressive borrowing raise severe risk flags for a sceptical analyst.

promises.promise: AUM growth of 20% to 24% in FY27.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 AUM grew by 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores, exceeding target range.
promises.why: Actual AUM growth surpassed the guided 20% to 24% range.

promises.promise: Improve opex-to-NTI by 25 to 40 basis points in FY27.
promises.actual: Too early for full year FY27 data, though Q2 FY27 op profit grew 28.6% YoY.
promises.why: Full-year FY27 opex-to-NTI data is not yet fully reported in quarterly FIN.

promises.promise: Credit costs to trend down to 145 to 160 basis points in FY27.
promises.actual: Too early for full-year FY27 credit cost metrics from exchange financials.
promises.why: FY27 full-year credit cost data is not available in FIN.

promises.promise: Return on Assets of 4.4% to 4.6% in FY27.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 PAT was INR 6,367 crores with 28.7% YoY growth.
promises.why: Full year ROA metrics for FY27 are not yet provided in FIN.

promises.promise: Return on Equity of 19% to 20% in FY27.
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 claimed ROE crossing 20%, Q2 FY27 PAT grew 28.7% to INR 6,367 crores.
promises.why: Q1 already crossed 20% ROE and strong PAT growth continues.

promises.promise: Add 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27.
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 added 5 million customers, showing rapid pace towards target.
promises.why: Customer additions are tracking ahead, leading management to hike guidance to 18-20m.

credibility.line: Management beats near-term volume and AUM targets, but evades upward revisions and hides cash flow deterioration behind strong PAT.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims robust asset growth and strong franchise expansion.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Q2 FY27 revenue reached INR 24,546 crores (up 22.8% YoY) and PAT hit INR 6,367 crores.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management boasts of high credit discipline and lower cost of funds.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: 5-year CFO-to-PAT is severely negative at -4.13 with last CFO at -65,790 crores.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management guides for sustainable balance sheet strength and stable ratios.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Debt-to-equity ratio sits at an elevated 4.08 with borrowings of INR 501,982 crores.

bull.point: Exceptional top-line and profit growth momentum across multiple quarters.
bull.evidence: Q2 FY27 PAT grew 28.7% YoY to INR 6,367 crores.

bull.point: Rapid scaling of new businesses like gold loans.
bull.evidence: Gold loan portfolio witnessed massive growth of 115% in Q4 FY26.

bull.point: Strong franchise expansion and customer acquisitions.
bull.evidence: Added 5 million new customers during Q1 FY27 alone.

bear.point: Catastrophic negative cash flows despite high reported accounting profits.
bear.evidence: 5-year FCF sum stands at -Rs 289,896 crores; last CFO is -Rs 65,790 crores.

bear.point: Dangerously high leverage and massive borrowing dependencies.
bear.evidence: Debt-to-equity ratio is 4.08 with total borrowings reaching INR 501,982 crores.

bear.point: Rising GNPA concerns and auditor warnings on complex IT systems.
bear.evidence: Auditor noted key audit matter on complex IT systems following migration.

watch_next: Cash flow conversion from reported accounting PAT.
Sustainability of high leverage and borrowing costs.
Asset quality and GNPA trends in MSME.
